title: Module contract, tool modules and presets
objective: Give ToolModule a geometry carry hook before a new geometry module needs one.
context_summary: Tool modules declare their source kinds and parameters; field patches cover the whole parameter vocabulary; one committed descriptor snapshot replaces hand-kept lists; ToolModule and the descriptor are trimmed; test modules are developer-only; and the registry-driven conformance suite proves the host-level properties once for every module. What remains is roadmap groundwork, blocked until a new geometry module is designed. Decisions: docs/decisions.md "Post-consolidation review"; constraints: docs/design/post-consolidation.md.

tasks.description: Give ToolModule a defaulted carry hook so a later geometry module is repositioned by the orientation the way the crop is today, instead of transform.rs naming the crop directly.
extra_context: Blocked: starts when the first new geometry module (for example upright or perspective) is designed.

modules/transform.rs imports crop::stored_payload and CROP_EFFECT directly and re-expresses only the crop through a turn, via CropPayload's carried method in modules/crop/geometry.rs: the one place a module reads and rewrites another module's stored payload (Basic's spec also takes the RAW module's white-balance control variants, but those are declared controls, not a payload). A second geometry effect placed after the orientation (an upright or perspective module, say) would keep its stored payload unchanged while its input stage turns, so it would silently address different image content; nothing today refuses this.

Non-affine geometry is out of scope for the hook itself: it would need a new host primitive through processing.rs, registry/compile.rs's output_stage, the point walk (render/pipeline.rs's Evaluation::entry_pixel), the byte driver and locate (render.rs), render/linear.rs and render/window.rs, wherever the render.rs split puts them. Record that in docs/design/architecture.md so a future module does not fake one through the carry hook.

acceptance_criteria: ToolModule gains a defaulted carry(effect_id, format, payload, input_stage, orientation) -> Result<Option<Value>> method whose default (None) means orientation-invariant.
transform.rs asks every geometry layer after the orientation through the registry's carry hook instead of naming the crop; the crop implements the hook with its existing carried arithmetic.
Orientation and crop rebase renders and tests are byte-identical before and after.
docs/design/architecture.md records that non-affine geometry needs a new host primitive beyond this hook.

steps: Add the defaulted carry hook to ToolModule
Move the crop's turn-carrying from transform.rs to the crop's own carry implementation
Run the orientation and crop rebase tests
commands: cargo run --release --locked --package xtask -- verify --tier quick --output NEW_DIR
expected_results: Orientation and crop rebase behavior is unchanged
transform.rs no longer imports the crop's payload type or effect id
